linked_repos.name: Mercury_KB
linked_repos.purpose: Obsidian vault with Mercury's knowledge, decisions, research and handoffs.
linked_repos.locate: Read the `kb_dir` key of `.handoff-config` in the main checkout (a gitignored file); see `.mercury/docs/guides/kb-structure.md`.
linked_repos.use: Read `.mercury/docs/guides/kb-structure.md` for the folder layout, then start from the navigation notes and the decision index in `00-index` of the vault; formal research is in `04-research` and decisions in `03-decisions`.
linked_repos.rules: Read when a task needs prior decisions or research. Writing needs its own authorized scope and follows the per-folder write rights in `.mercury/docs/guides/kb-structure.md`.
